context_notes: The most consequential finding of the phase was a BOOKKEEPING TAG THAT SPENT THE BUDGET: harness.budget.look_count matches (segment_manifest_id, segment_name) across EVERY experiment, and segment_manifest_id is a mandatory tag, so a run tagged segment_name="val" IS a counted look. Measured: look_count(val) read 2 after one honest look and 3 after a cache-only re-invocation. The key is now scored_segment_name. Any new tracked run must not carry segment_name unless it IS a look. Second: a frozen predictor body is located by the recipe MINUS code_hash, because the freeze runs at a later commit than the select by design. Third: etime is globally unique and strictly sorted across all 60,926,503 decision rows, so the join key is etime alone -- decision_seq is NOT unique. Fourth: never pin a coefficient or prediction digest as a committed constant -- numpy links Apple Accelerate here and OpenBLAS in CI.
